# ProcGrep research subset

This directory contains the unmodified ProcGrep 0.1.3 modules used by this
study: BPE vocabulary fitting, trace encoding, Jensen–Shannon divergence, and
their shared data types. The source is pinned to commit
`a98b30e7391a1f42d93e05db7999b0ad21b881f5` from
[hamidahoderinwale/procgrep](https://github.com/hamidahoderinwale/procgrep).

The minimal `__init__.py` is a local import shim. Upstream source is distributed
under the adjacent MIT license; upstream copyright and license text are kept
intact. This subset is included for reproducibility and is not maintained as a
separate fork of the full ProcGrep project.
